custody_model: The reviewed Simple Earn Agreement governs subscriptions through the HTX platform. It does not establish a segregated bank-deposit or trust structure for the reviewed product; flexible subscriptions are matched with borrowing demand generated by HTX services.
yield_source: For Flexible products, HTX states it endeavors to match subscribed assets with borrowing demand arising from other HTX services. Flexible rates fluctuate with market conditions. Fixed-term products use the rate prevailing at subscription under the applicable term.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform exposure, variable flexible rates, borrower/market demand, liquidity and service-operation risk, fixed-term lock-up and the broad investment risks identified in the Simple Earn Agreement. Promotional principal-return mechanics do not establish a universal solvency guarantee.

custody_model: Reviewed CoinEx product materials describe assets being subscribed into the Flexible Savings/Financial Account product and redeemed back to the Spot account. They do not establish a segregated trust, bank-deposit or universal title-protection structure for subscribed assets.
yield_source: CoinEx states that Flexible Savings yields are linked to borrowing interest rates from Margin Trading and Loans, with additional CoinEx subsidies in the current product. Historical Financial Account material described allocating a portion of margin borrowed-coin interest to users.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform exposure, floating/possibly zero rates, borrower-demand dependence, liquidity constraints and delayed redemption when idle savings assets are insufficient until borrowers return coins. Marketing descriptions such as low-risk or principal-protected are not treated as universal custody or solvency guarantees.
